title: Estimation of direct and indirect polygenic effects and gene-environment interactions using polygenic scores in case-parent trio studies.
abstract: PGS-TRI, a framework for analyzing polygenic scores (PGSs) in case-parent trio studies that estimates risk associated with direct PGS effects, gene-environment interactions and asymmetrical maternal and paternal indirect effects. Applied to multi-ancestry ASD trios (n=18,383), it yielded transmission-based direct effects of PGSs for ASD and other neurocognitive traits along a genetic ancestry continuum, and identified asymmetrical indirect effects of parental PGSs for BMI and neurocognitive traits on children's ASD risk.
